player_prompt.intro:
Nanhte Player {player_id} Nim re.
Nanhte a lam acha kawp kashun kaja ai.
Kaja shani shagu kawp kashun kaja wa, kaja shagu kawp kashun kaja ai.
'[pile quantity]' ngai hku format hta ka, pile ngai hku index kaja ai, quantity ngai hku kaja shagu hpe kaja ai.
Hpang shani, '[0 3]' ngai hku pile 0 kaw na 3 kaja shagu hpe kaja ai.

state.current_pile: Ya aten hta nga ai Hpungtang: {piles}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kaja format hku n re. '[pile quantity]' hku format hta ka.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Player {player_id}, kaja ai n re. Column {col} jaw ai n re.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Pile index {pile_index} gaw n lawm ai.
invalid_move.non_positive: Hkum htum arai langai ngai hpe la kau ra ai.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Pile {pile_index} kaw na {quantity} hpe kaja ai n re (jaw {pile_count} hku n re).

observation.removed_from_piles: Player {player_id} hku hta [{pile_index} {quantity}], {quantity} hku hku hku hta hpun {pile_index} hta.

outcome.win: Player {player_id} gaw hpang jahtum na object hpe lu la sai!
